title: 第329章 休整第328章 进驻
slug: 异界冒险从组建冒险团开始
content_zh:
等到沃尔讲完自己的安排，众人便开始各自安排接下来的工作，最苦恼的就是薇拉，作为斥候总长，他手下除了伯特和雾鬃都是新人，虽然在潜行和杀人这方面已经完全合格，但作为职业游荡者的其他方面，却还非常欠缺。
作为游荡者，除了杀人，要学的东西非常多，开锁、伪装、扒窃、跟踪、制作和解除陷阱、毒药的制作和反制、侦查和反侦查、甚至各种势力的情报和辨识能力……
对此，沃尔也只能鼓励几句，并将购买的诡术师魔法传承书籍交给她，里面记录着两个一环法术，分别是可以改变外貌形态的自我伪装，和可以致盲敌人的七彩喷射，还有一个二环法术，侦测魔法，如果薇拉学会它，就不怕在侦查的时候被敌人的魔法陷阱坑到了。
薇拉也只能收下魔法书后，准备将原本用来研究菜品和骑龙的时间腾一些出来，用于研究魔法和教导斥候们游荡者技巧。
而战士们要学的东西也不少，这个沃尔只能亲自出手，昨天才加入的那些新人战士懂得稍微多一点，但大多还是野路子出身。
沃尔也想要借助这段时间好好沉淀一下，他的实力增长太快，几个月的时间，就从正式职业者成为高阶职业者，走完其他人十年的路程，很多有用的战斗技巧都还来不及掌握。
比如加雷斯教官给的书中就有一招适合冠军勇士的技巧，叫做强效重击，通过蓄力技巧，在击中敌人薄弱部位时，能造成更大的伤害，以求在最短时间内解决敌人！
还有一些可以通过训练提升个人实力的技巧，教官将这种技巧称为“专长”
，顾名思义，就是一种独门技巧，特殊绝活。
当然，大部分专长是和个人天赋，甚至血脉息息相关，只有少数是能够后天学习，而且训练方法还常常被老师藏一手，导致只有极少数人能够掌握。
比如沃尔所在的职业者学院，就有几种专长可供选择学习，盲斗、重击和盔甲专精。
当时沃尔年轻气盛，选择了提升破坏力的重击，如果学成，就能获得一个重武器大师的称号，能让双手重武器威力大增，甚至能在杀死敌人后再瞬间衔接二次打击，短时间内杀死多名敌人。
即使还未学成，沃尔也已经受益匪浅，这段时间经历的实战很多，他已经对其间技巧有所领悟，或许很快就能学有所成。
而这些训练方法，沃尔也能教给手下的兄弟，他们的各项属性是绝对达标的，只要多训练，多战斗，迟早能成为战士中的佼佼者！
听完沃尔的话，众人都很是兴奋，对接下来的训练充满期待。
散会后，沃尔和莉亚手牵手向楼上隔音最好的房间走去，莉亚这才开口说道：
“团长，关于专长训练，我看过不少资料，里面记载着很多训练方法，但其中真伪存疑……”
进入房间后，莉亚开始为沃尔解下身上的板甲，用魔法一件件清理干净，挂在房间内的盔甲架上，沃尔对莉亚所说的专长很感兴趣，笑着询问道：
“哦～都有哪些？或许我可以选择其中几项进行尝试。”
这时，外面传来轻微的敲门声，沃尔光着膀子开门，将一个冒着热气的水桶提进屋内，并对送来热水的战士表示了感谢。

虽然莉亚的法术可以清洁身体，但淋雨之后，还是用热水擦拭一下身体更舒服，莉亚的手指划过沃尔强壮结实的肌肉，长耳朵高高扬起，她声音温柔道：
“嗯，确实有几种比较实用，真实性也较高的训练方法，比如哨兵训练法，可以让受训者对周围的敌人进行快速反击，减少被偷袭的可能，机动训练法，增强移动速度，躲避敌人下意识的攻击，强壮训练法，打磨肉体，增强对伤害的抵抗力……”
沃尔也没有只顾清洗自己的身体，一边和莉亚讨论着专长的训练方案，一边也解开莉亚头上的发带，取出药膏轻轻搓洗，梳理着她的秀发。
他对这些专长很感兴趣，但无一不需要数月甚至数年才能掌握，并没有一蹴而就的捷径，只能尝试将其融入日常训练，期待未来有所成就。
两人久违地亲热了一番，这才相拥而眠，直到第二天清晨，太阳的光芒照进屋子，沃尔才醒来。
“嗯～舒坦！”
沃尔也很久没睡得这么舒坦，差点没舍得起床，和同样懒在床上，只是想和他多待一会的莉亚相视一笑，两人这才开始起床洗漱。
走到窗边，沃尔打开百叶窗看向天空，竟然碧蓝如洗，如同一块剔透的蓝宝石，没有一丝云朵，是个大晴天，他心情大好，说道：
“好天气啊，正适合让兄弟们放松放松。”
莉亚看着天上的蓝天，却有些忧虑道：“团长，这几天的天气有些奇怪，好像一直在吹东风。”
沃尔并没有太在意，穿戴好板甲后，便牵着莉亚一起下楼道：“嗯，这个可以和薇拉确认一下，她一直飞在天上，应该知道得比较清楚。”
这时，楼下已经坐满了正在低声交谈、吃着热腾腾麦粥的战士，见沃尔下楼，纷纷起身笑着打招呼道：
“团长，早上好！”
“莉亚法师，早上好！”
“日安，团长……”
沃尔也笑着一一回应，排队从打饭的半兽人姑娘手中接过一碗蔬菜小麦粥和一碟腌黄瓜，坐到霍恩和扎木合几人旁边，莉亚则走到另一边姑娘们中间，嬉笑着聊天去了。
坐下后，沃尔呲溜着麦粥，拿起桌上的面包啃了起来，霍恩几人打过招呼后，也没有因为沃尔的到来而终止刚才的话题，而是继续讨论着，蟾蜍人满背的疙瘩，平时怎么睡觉的奇怪话题。
沃尔也加入了讨论，最终疙瘩凹陷床论败北，得出了蟾蜍人应该和蟾蜍一样，是趴在泥里睡觉的结论。
见沃尔等人的讨论告一段落，已经吃完早餐的薇拉走了过来，开始向沃尔汇报昨天晚上斥候们打探到的情报：
“昨天为难我们的那个贵族叫西里尔·德·维涅，是领主的次子，头衔是骑士，职位是卫兵队长，现居住在内城的领主城堡二楼左边第二个房间，常去的地方有……”

：。
content_en:
After Wall finished explaining his arrangements, everyone began to arrange the next work. The most troubled one was Vera. As the scout chief, all his subordinates except Burt and Misty Mane were new. Although they were fully qualified in terms of stealth and killing, as a professional rogue, they were still very lacking in other aspects.
As a rogue, in addition to killing, you have to learn many things, such as unlocking, disguise, pickpocketing, tracking, making and disarming traps, poison production and countermeasures, investigation and counter-inspection, and even the intelligence and identification capabilities of various forces...
In this regard, Wall could only give her a few words of encouragement, and handed her the Trickster's Magic Heritage Book that he purchased, which recorded two first-level spells, namely self-disguise that can change the appearance, and colorful jet that can blind the enemy. There is also a second-level spell, detection magic. If Vera learns it, she will not be afraid of being trapped by the enemy's magic trap during detection.
Vera could only accept the magic book, and planned to free up some time that was originally used to study dishes and ride dragons, and use it to study magic and teach the scouts rogue skills.
The soldiers have a lot to learn. This Wall can only take action himself. The new warriors who joined yesterday know a little more, but most of them are from wild backgrounds.
Wall also wanted to use this period of time to settle down. His strength grew too fast. In a few months, he went from a formal professional to a high-level professional, completing the ten-year journey of others. Many useful combat skills were not yet mastered.
For example, the book given by instructor Gareth has a technique suitable for champion warriors, called powerful heavy attack. Through the charging technique, when hitting the weak part of the enemy, it can cause greater damage, so as to defeat the enemy in the shortest time!
There are also skills that can be improved through training, which instructors call "expertise"
, as the name suggests, is a unique skill, a special skill.
Of course, most expertise is closely related to personal talent or even blood, and only a few can be learned. Moreover, training methods are often hidden by teachers, resulting in only a handful of people being able to master them.
For example, the Professional Academy where Wall is located has several specialties to choose from, including blind fighting, heavy attack, and armor specialization.
At that time, Wall was young and energetic, so he chose heavy attacks that increased the destructive power. If he succeeded in learning, he would be able to obtain the title of a heavy weapons master, which would greatly increase the power of heavy weapons in both hands. He could even kill an enemy and then immediately follow up with a second strike, killing multiple enemies in a short time.
Even if he has not yet completed his studies, Wall has already benefited a lot. He has experienced a lot of actual combat during this period. He has already understood the techniques and may be able to learn them soon.
Wall can also teach these training methods to his brothers. Their attributes are absolutely up to standard. As long as they train more and fight more, they will become the best among warriors sooner or later!
After listening to Wall's words, everyone was very excited and looked forward to the next training.
After the meeting, Wall and Leah walked hand in hand to the room with the best soundproofing upstairs, and then Leah said:
"Captain, I have read a lot of information about specialty training, which records many training methods, but the authenticity is questionable..."
After entering the room, Leah began to take off Wall's plate armor, cleaned it piece by piece with magic, and hung it on the armor rack in the room. Wall was very interested in Leah's expertise and asked with a smile:
"Oh~ what are they? Maybe I can choose a few of them to try."
At this time, there was a slight knock on the door. Wall opened the door shirtless, carried a steaming bucket into the house, and expressed his gratitude to the soldier who brought the hot water.
Although Leah's spell can clean the body, after getting wet in the rain, it is more comfortable to wipe the body with hot water. Leah's fingers crossed Volqiang'sWith strong muscles and long ears raised high, she said in a gentle voice:
"Well, there are indeed several more practical and more realistic training methods, such as the sentry training method, which allows trainees to quickly counterattack surrounding enemies and reduce the possibility of being attacked by sneak attacks; the maneuver training method, which increases movement speed and avoids subconscious attacks from enemies; the strength training method, which polishes the body and enhances resistance to damage..."
Wall didn't just clean his body. While discussing the training plan for his specialty with Leah, he also untied the hair tie on Leah's head, took out the ointment, gently scrubbed it, and combed her hair.
He is very interested in these specialties, but they all take months or even years to master. There is no shortcut to overnight success. He can only try to integrate them into daily training and look forward to achieving success in the future.
The two had a long-awaited intimacy and then fell asleep hugging each other. It wasn't until early the next morning that Wall woke up when the sun's rays shone into the house.
"Hmm~ Comfortable!"
Wall hadn't slept so comfortably for a long time, and he almost didn't want to get up. He smiled at each other with Leah, who was also lazy in bed and just wanted to stay with him for a while, and then the two of them started to get up and wash up.
Walking to the window, Wall opened the blinds and looked at the sky. It was as blue as a crystal, like a clear sapphire. There was no cloud at all. It was a sunny day. He was in a good mood and said:
"The weather is nice, just perfect for brothers to relax."
Lia looked at the blue sky, but said with some worry: "Captain, the weather has been a bit strange these days, it seems that the east wind has been blowing."
Wall didn't pay too much attention. After putting on the plate armor, he led Leah downstairs and said, "Well, you can confirm this with Vera. She has been flying in the sky and should know better."
At this time, the downstairs was already full of soldiers who were talking in low voices and eating hot wheat porridge. When they saw Wall coming downstairs, they all stood up and said hello with a smile:
"Commander, good morning!"
"Mage Leah, good morning!"
"Good day, Captain..."
Wall also responded with a smile, queued up and took a bowl of vegetable wheat porridge and a plate of pickled cucumbers from the half-orc girl who was cooking, and sat next to Horn and Zamuhe. Leah walked to the other side among the girls, laughing and chatting.
After sitting down, Wall sipped the wheat porridge, picked up the bread on the table and started to nibble. After Horn and others said hello, they did not end the conversation because of Wall's arrival. Instead, they continued to discuss the strange topics of the bumps on the toad's back and how he usually sleeps.
Wall also joined the discussion, and in the end the sunken bed theory was defeated, and he came to the conclusion that toad people should sleep in the mud like toads.
Seeing that the discussion between Wall and others came to an end, Vera, who had already finished breakfast, came over and began to report to Wall the intelligence that the scouts had gathered last night:
"The nobleman who made trouble for us yesterday is called Cyril de Vigne. He is the second son of the lord. His title is a knight and his position is captain of the guard. He currently lives in the second room on the left on the second floor of the lord's castle in the inner city. His usual places are..."
